verdict.rationale: Abacum's investor-reporting page says the deck builds itself with no copy-paste between model and slides, which implies slide output. Its first-party Excel connector pushes and pulls data between Abacum and Excel, covering spreadsheet output. Neither is documented as a report export feature, and PDF is never mentioned. Missing for 10: explicit report export documentation, PDF export, details on slide formats (e.g., PowerPoint/Google Slides), independent or hands-on corroboration.
